root_cause_evidence.finding: ctx1024 Q4 prefill wall 2512 ms (1053 tok / 419.5 tok/s): GPU busy 38.8 ms (1.5%), QmmPrefillCoopmatF16 total 6.1 ms over 163 dispatches (mean 37.5 us), join_wait 2256.7 ms over 48 joins (p90 97.7 ms), submit() 591 ms over 148 calls (p50 4.5 ms), intra-submission gaps p50 34.9 us with a full pre+post memory barrier per dispatch (19915 emitted, 0 skipped).
root_cause_evidence.causal_chain_static: kBatchByteBudgetDivisor=16 (allocator limit/16 ~= 320 MB quarantine) flushes every ~25 dispatches -> ~70 batches per pass -> mlx transforms.cpp MAX_ACTIVE_TASKS=10 throttles -> gpu::finalize + scheduler::wait_for_one join stalls; every submission waits on the previous via completion timeline (in-order, no cross-submission overlap).
root_cause_evidence.caveat_from_main: profiled attribution is not unprofiled proof; the divisor sweep below measures unprofiled wall time with settings controlled (MLX_OMARCHY_BATCH_BYTES_DIVISOR env on the same wheel).

kept_pending_gpu_results: 82ececc6 inline-fragment Q4 prefill: A fragments unpack f16 word pairs, B fragments dequantize fused 9-word blocks per (column, 64-group) inside the coopmat fragment load; k loop has no shared staging and no barriers; dequant stays f32 scale*nibble+bias (ffma) - the qmm tile contract, never f16.

5c7876ac dense f32 coopmat rewritten from the 8x8 global-load tile (0.28 TFLOP/s, dense receipt) to a staged 32x32 tile (2 KiB shared, 16 MMA per k step, tails masked, alignment gates dropped); bf16 dense rides MatmulBF16Coopmat with exact bf16->f32 widening and matmul.comp bf16_store RNE word packing (no numerics change vs the 16x16 tile).
